title: Independent audit of OpenAI's October 2026 AI-generated mathematics
description:
An independent audit of selected unformalized results from OpenAI's October 2026 collection of AI-generated mathematics manuscripts (github.com/openai/math), plus Lean 4 formalizations of some combinatorial parts (Hindman's sum-product problem, result 164: Lemma 2.5 and Corollary 1.2, with a self-contained finite Ramsey theorem).

The audits and the Lean code were written by Anthropic's Claude (Opus 5.5) acting as research agents, under the direction of the repository owner, who is not a professional mathematician. Findings were re-checked against the LaTeX sources and reviewed independently by OpenAI's Codex (GPT-6.1); that review overturned one original finding, which is kept in the repository as a withdrawn finding. No finding has been reviewed by a domain expert. Please treat them as leads for experts, not as verdicts. Audit reports are in Japanese.
